label: Mining speed
description: Always increases correct-tool mining speed.

label: Fortune
description: Adds stochastically rounded native Fortune levels, capped at III.

label: Magnetized
description: Pulls only your freshly mined drops toward you, never thrown items.

label: Silk touch
description: Chance to generate native Silk Touch loot; exclusive with the base Fortune and Smelter families.

label: Reinforced
description: Increases maximum durability on any reconstructed tool.

label: Scholar
description: Increases block and furnace experience; suppressed by Silk Touch.

label: Aquatic
description: Recovers a fraction of the underwater mining penalty.

label: Steady hands
description: Recovers a fraction of the airborne mining penalty.

label: Long reach
description: Adds native block interaction range in the main hand.

label: Smelter
description: Chance to apply the real furnace recipe to each drop, preserving recipe counts and XP.

label: Phasebound
description: Chance to put final mined drops directly into your inventory; overflow remains in the world.

label: Hardwearing
description: Chance to prevent each durability point before native Unbreaking.

label: Deep reserves
description: Adds flat maximum durability, after the Reinforced multiplier.

label: Self repair
description: Repairs this held tool every ten seconds.

label: Mending affinity
description: Repairs extra durability on XP pickup without consuming additional player XP.

label: Frugal repairs
description: Reduces anvil level and material costs on nonempty repairs; costs never fall below one.

label: Nugget maintenance
description: While crouching, consumes an iron nugget every ten seconds to repair durability.

label: Rain tempered
description: Repairs every ten seconds while exposed to rain or submerged.

label: Lightweight grip
description: Adds main-hand movement speed as a fraction of base speed.

label: Braced grip
description: Adds main-hand knockback resistance.

label: Guarded grip
description: Adds main-hand armor points.

label: Vital grip
description: Adds main-hand maximum health points; two points equal one heart.

label: Stonecutter
description: Increases mining speed while common stone.

label: Ore runner
description: Increases mining speed while ores.

label: Sediment cutter
description: Increases mining speed while sand, gravel, clay or dirt.

label: Deep delver
description: Increases mining speed while blocks below Y=0.

label: Sunstruck
description: Increases mining speed while daylight with open sky.

label: Night shift
description: Increases mining speed in low ambient light (below eight), including dark caves.

label: Water cooled
description: Increases mining speed while rain or water.

label: Heat tempered
description: Increases mining speed while the Nether or within two blocks of lava.

label: Planted stance
description: Increases mining speed while standing still.

label: Mining rhythm
description: Increases mining speed while up to five consecutive breaks less than three seconds apart.

label: Varied strata
description: Increases mining speed while switching to a different block within three seconds.

label: Last legs
description: Increases mining speed while less than 25% durability remaining.

label: Calibrated edge
description: Increases mining speed while more than 75% durability remaining.

label: Prospector
description: Adds fractional native Fortune levels on any ore; combined Fortune remains capped at III.

label: Gem cutter
description: Adds fractional native Fortune levels on diamond, emerald or lapis ores; combined Fortune remains capped at III.

label: Redstone savant
description: Adds fractional native Fortune levels on redstone ores; combined Fortune remains capped at III.

label: Coal splitter
description: Adds fractional native Fortune levels on coal ores; combined Fortune remains capped at III.

label: Metal splitter
description: Adds fractional native Fortune levels on iron, copper or gold ores; combined Fortune remains capped at III.

label: Deep knowledge
description: Additional mining XP below Y=0.

label: Ore knowledge
description: Additional mining XP on ores.

label: Experienced rhythm
description: Additional mining XP during a consecutive mining chain.

label: Experience condenser
description: Banks half of mining XP and releases the bank on every fifth primary break, conserving total XP.

label: Echoing spoils
description: Chance to copy one final, non-Silk, non-container drop stack, up to eight extra items.

label: Gem echo
description: Chance for one extra matching gem; five-second cooldown.

label: Lucky edge
description: Chance to repair two durability after an ore break.

label: Gravel sifter
description: Chance: Converts a gravel drop into flint. Disabled by Silk Touch and on secondary breaks.

label: Vitrifier
description: Chance: Converts sand drops into glass. Disabled by Silk Touch and on secondary breaks.

label: Clay kiln
description: Chance: Converts clay balls into bricks. Disabled by Silk Touch and on secondary breaks.

label: Stone smoother
description: Chance: Converts cobblestone into stone. Disabled by Silk Touch and on secondary breaks.

label: Slate polisher
description: Chance: Converts cobbled deepslate into polished deepslate. Disabled by Silk Touch and on secondary breaks.

label: Metal filings
description: Chance: Adds one iron or gold nugget after mining the corresponding ore. Disabled by Silk Touch and on secondary breaks.

label: Fossil dust
description: Chance: Adds one bone meal when mining calcite or tuff. Disabled by Silk Touch and on secondary breaks.

label: Web salvage
description: Chance: Adds one string when cutting cobweb. Disabled by Silk Touch and on secondary breaks.

label: Prismatic salvage
description: Chance: Adds an amethyst shard when breaking an amethyst cluster. Disabled by Silk Touch and on secondary breaks.

label: Moss salvage
description: Chance: Adds bone meal when mining moss. Disabled by Silk Touch and on secondary breaks.

label: Vein miner
description: Mines Connected same-type ore blocks. Native breaks consume durability and respect break-event cancellation. Shared budget: twelve extra blocks.

label: Tunneler
description: Mines A straight line behind the mined block. Crouch to activate. Native breaks consume durability and respect break-event cancellation. Shared budget: twelve extra blocks.

label: Broadhead
description: Mines A plane perpendicular to your view. Crouch to activate. Native breaks consume durability and respect break-event cancellation. Shared budget: twelve extra blocks.

label: Stairmaker
description: Mines A descending staircase ahead. Crouch to activate. Native breaks consume durability and respect break-event cancellation. Shared budget: twelve extra blocks.

label: Surface scraper
description: Mines Nearby matching sediment blocks. Native breaks consume durability and respect break-event cancellation. Shared budget: twelve extra blocks.

label: Gravel vacuum
description: Mines The gravel or sand column above the break. Native breaks consume durability and respect break-event cancellation. Shared budget: twelve extra blocks.

label: Branching veins
description: Mines Adjacent ores, even of different types. Native breaks consume durability and respect break-event cancellation. Shared budget: twelve extra blocks.

label: Crystal sweep
description: Mines Nearby mature amethyst clusters; budding amethyst is never targeted. Native breaks consume durability and respect break-event cancellation. Shared budget: twelve extra blocks.

label: Obsidian chisel
description: Mines Adjacent matching obsidian blocks. Native breaks consume durability and respect break-event cancellation. Shared budget: twelve extra blocks.

label: Support mason
description: Places inventory cobblestone below the mined cell when it is unsupported. Placement events can cancel; resources are consumed only on success.

label: Lightbearer
description: Places an inventory torch in the mined cell when light is low. Placement events can cancel; resources are consumed only on success.

label: Lava cork
description: Consumes cobblestone to plug one adjacent exposed lava cell. Placement events can cancel; resources are consumed only on success.

label: Water cork
description: Consumes cobblestone to plug one adjacent exposed water cell. Placement events can cancel; resources are consumed only on success.

label: Bridgework
description: While crouching, places inventory cobblestone directly beneath your feet. Placement events can cancel; resources are consumed only on success.

label: Green thumb
description: Consumes bone meal to turn nearby exposed dirt into grass, never replacing other blocks. Placement events can cancel; resources are consumed only on success.

label: Night sight
description: Grants ten seconds of night vision on a primary break.
milestones: Effect duration/radius grows at milestone stages; ten-second cooldown.

label: Prospector sprint
description: Grants three seconds of Speed I after an ore break.
milestones: Effect duration/radius grows at milestone stages; ten-second cooldown.

label: Stone skin
description: Grants three seconds of Resistance I after a stone break.
milestones: Effect duration/radius grows at milestone stages; ten-second cooldown.

label: Fire ward
description: Grants three seconds of fire resistance after mining near lava.
milestones: Effect duration/radius grows at milestone stages; ten-second cooldown.

label: Gem ward
description: Grants four seconds of Absorption I after a gem ore break.
milestones: Effect duration/radius grows at milestone stages; ten-second cooldown.

label: Soft landing
description: Grants three seconds of Slow Falling after an airborne break.
milestones: Effect duration/radius grows at milestone stages; ten-second cooldown.

label: Echo chamber
description: Slows nearby hostile mobs after an ore break; never targets players or animals.
milestones: Effect duration/radius grows at milestone stages; ten-second cooldown.

label: Quarry mark
description: Makes nearby hostile mobs glow after an ore break.
milestones: Effect duration/radius grows at milestone stages; ten-second cooldown.

label: Desperate pulse
description: At less than four hearts, knocks nearby hostile mobs away after mining.
milestones: Effect duration/radius grows at milestone stages; ten-second cooldown.

label: Air pockets
description: Restores air ticks on underwater primary breaks.

label: Miner sustenance
description: Chance to restore one food point; ten-second cooldown.

label: Recoil step
description: Crouch mining steps you safely backward into loaded, collision-free space; ten-second cooldown.

label: Resonant battery
description: Generates resonance on primary breaks; capacity 100.

label: Overcharge
description: Consumes four resonance on a primary break for temporary Haste I; ten-second cooldown.

label: Gem battery
description: Generates extra resonance on gem ore breaks.

label: Kinetic battery
description: Moving at least one block while holding the tool generates one resonance, at most once every three seconds.

label: Experience battery
description: Converts one point of the current mining XP into resonance, never generates XP.

label: Quarry discharge
description: Spends five resonance to mine a cross around a primary break. Shared area budget applies.

label: Spoils discharge
description: Spends three resonance to duplicate up to four items from one final drop; non-Silk, five-second cooldown.

label: Mending discharge
description: Spends four resonance to repair the tool; ten-second cooldown.

label: Shared momentum
description: Spends six resonance to grant Haste I to nearby allied players; ten-second cooldown.

label: Alternating current
description: Alternating ore and stone breaks within three seconds generates resonance.

label: Knowledge siphon
description: Grants mining XP directly, suppressing its orbs; this bypasses vanilla orb-based Mending.

label: Apprentice resonance
description: Chance to grant one extra tool XP after a valid primary break; ascension gates still apply.

label: Careful mason
description: Chance not to consume the material for a successful utility placement; you must still own it.

label: Precision silk
description: Silk Touch chance while standing still. Shares the base harvest exclusion group.

label: Pocket press
description: Converts nine plain inventory ingredients into one block or ingot after mining; never processes named or component-bearing ingredients.
milestones: Raw iron/gold; then copper; then coal/redstone/lapis; then diamonds/emeralds. Five-second cooldown.

label: Spoils ward
description: Temporarily prevents damage to your final mined drops via the native invulnerability-check event; underlying entity flags remain unchanged.

label: Choking dust
description: Mining sediment weakens nearby hostile mobs for three seconds; ten-second cooldown.

label: Pyroclastic
description: High smelting chance; successful furnace processing also increases furnace XP.

label: Cinder chain
description: Successful smelting generates resonance.

label: Soul furnace
description: Spends one player XP to smelt all eligible drops of a primary break; never overrides Silk Touch.

label: Basalt heart
description: Nether stone breaks grant Resistance I and repair durability; ten-second cooldown.

label: Magma reservoir
description: Mining near lava generates resonance.

label: Soul cleanse
description: Mining soul sand or soul soil removes Poison, Wither, Slowness or Weakness; ten-second cooldown.

label: Piglin purse
description: Chance for one extra gold nugget on gold ores; never triggers on Silk Touch.

label: Ghast breath
description: Spends five resonance to knock away and ignite nearby hostile mobs; ten-second cooldown.

label: Emberlight
description: Spends two resonance to create a soul torch in a dark mined cell; placement events still apply.

label: Infernal echo
description: Spends four resonance to break additional connected Nether ores; shared area limit applies.

label: Chorus hop
description: Spends four resonance to safely teleport forward when crouch mining; ten-second cooldown.

label: Ender dispatch
description: After Phasebound, sends overflow drops to your Ender Chest; full storage leaves exact remainders in world.

label: Repulsor
description: Knocks nearby hostile mobs away after an ore break; ten-second cooldown.

label: Entanglement
description: Spends two resonance to give one resonance to a nearby allied player's reconstructed pickaxe; ten-second cooldown.

label: Temporal echo
description: Spends three resonance to prime a duplicate of one item on the next primary break within ten seconds; non-Silk only.

label: Shulker pulse
description: Spends five resonance to levitate nearby hostile mobs; ten-second cooldown.

label: Endstone alchemy
description: Spends five resonance for a 15% chance of one pearl when mining End Stone; ten-second cooldown.

label: Void anchor
description: Spends twenty resonance to return you to the last safe position recorded while holding this tool in this dimension; sixty-second cooldown.

label: Dimensional battery
description: Successful Phasebound collection generates resonance once per primary break.
